title: PUT /v1/device/tasks/{task}/modes/{mode} request
description: The outcome of an operation task.mode that this device executes (ADR-098 section 3, way sentence): on or off. The quote was checked on the device and stays sealed in the operation's parameters; the hub accepts the outcome only for an executing task.mode operation of this task on this device and takes the chooser from the operation's triggered_by (a writer of the workgroup for on).
